title: Zero-Trust Device Attestation Using Hardware-Bound Credentials
problem: Network access decisions rely on credentials that can be copied from a compromised device, and devices are trusted for long periods after a single successful login.
solution: Each device holds a private key sealed in a hardware security module and produces a signed attestation of its firmware measurements on every access request. A policy engine verifies the signature and measurements against an approved list, grants access scoped to a single session, and requires fresh attestation when the session token expires or the device posture changes.

elements.text: A private key sealed in a hardware security module of the device
Generation by the device of a signed attestation of firmware measurements with each access request
A policy engine that verifies the signature and compares the measurements with an approved list
Granting of access scoped to a single session
Expiry of the session token after a time limit
A requirement for fresh attestation when the session token expires or the device posture changes

dependent_features: Revocation of an approved measurement takes effect on the next request
